title: Value from the first bit and tail
statement: For every finite bit string $w$, its little-endian value equals twice the little-endian value of its tail plus the numeric value of its first bit, taking the first bit to be $0$ when $w$ is empty.
replaced: For every bit list $w$, the value of $w$ equals twice the value of its tail plus the numeric value of its first digit, where an empty word contributes a zero digit.
